company.name: Asteroid
company.shortDescription: Browser-based AI agents for healthcare operations
company.description: Asteroid automates mission-critical browser workflows at scale. Continuously learning AI agents handle complex healthcare operations such as prior authorizations, payer portal navigation, and EHR tasks — with built-in safeguards and human oversight.

productsAndServices.description: A HIPAA-ready platform that uses browser, desktop, Citrix, and API-based agents to automate healthcare workflows across EHRs, payer portals, registries, and other systems without public APIs.
productsAndServices.name: Asteroid Healthcare Automation Platform

productsAndServices.description: Prebuilt and configurable agents for repetitive healthcare operations, including credentialing, enrollment, prior authorization, eligibility, claims, scheduling, referrals, Medicare, and EHR extraction or write-back.
productsAndServices.name: Healthcare Workflow Automation

productsAndServices.description: An AI agent builder that converts a process description or standard operating procedure into a configurable browser agent, allowing non-engineers to create and run workflow automations.
productsAndServices.name: Astro Builder

productsAndServices.description: A professional service in which Asteroid maps a customer’s workflow, customizes existing integrations or builds new agents, and deploys them into the customer’s production workspace.
productsAndServices.name: Managed Agent Delivery

productsAndServices.description: Agents that automate multi-carrier insurance quoting, renewal data entry, and claims-status workflows across carrier portals, reducing repetitive manual entry and information retrieval.
productsAndServices.name: Insurance Portal Automation
